title: Ensure pre-commit hook runs generate:types after payload.config.ts changes
body: The stale payload-types.ts was not caught before commit. Consider adding a pre-commit hook that runs 'git diff payload.config.ts && pnpm generate:types' to ensure types are always regenerated when the config changes.
rationale: If a pre-commit hook validated payload.config.ts changes and auto-regenerated types, this CI failure would have been caught locally.
